meta_description: Fab Interiors Ltd is a trusted electrician in Leicester offering rewiring, installations, repairs and maintenance. Fast, reliable service. Call now.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Approved — Domestic & Commercial Electrical Work
hero_subhead: From faulty wiring to complete rewires, we diagnose and fix electrical problems fast. Same-day appointments available.
services_subhead: Whether you need an urgent repair, a new installation, or a full property rewire, we've got the skills and experience to get it done safely.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, burnt-out sockets — we diagnose faults quickly and fix them on the spot. No call-out charge for local Leicester jobs.

services.title: Full Property Rewiring
services.desc: Modernise old wiring and bring your home up to current regulations. We handle the whole job—testing, certification, and making good afterwards.

services.title: Fuseboard & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace ageing fuse boxes with modern MCB boards. Improves safety, gives you more circuits, and often reduces your insurance premiums.

services.title: New Sockets, Switches & Lighting
services.desc: Add power points where you need them, install dimmers, smart switches, or complete lighting schemes. All fully tested and certified.

services.title: Boiler Installations & Wiring
services.desc: Professional electrical installation for new boilers and heating systems. We work alongside plumbers and heating engineers for seamless jobs.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Inspection
services.desc: Annual safety checks and full EICR reports for landlords and homeowners. Identify hazards before they become serious.

about_pullquote: I started this to show Leicester that electricians can be honest, on time, and properly qualified.
about_para_1: Fab Interiors Ltd has been keeping Leicester homes and businesses safe and powered since 2006. We're based in Aylestone and cover the whole city and surrounding areas. Our founder trained as an electrician with a family business in the East Midlands and saw an opportunity to bring reliable, no-nonsense electrical work to Leicester residents who were tired of cowboys and inflated quotes.
about_para_2: We're NICEIC approved and hold full Part P certification—every job is tested, certified, and guaranteed. Our customers come back because we turn up when we say we will, we explain what needs doing, and we charge fair prices. We're not the flashiest outfit, but we're the electrician Leicester trusts.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called them Monday morning with a dodgy socket that was sparking. They came out same day, found the problem in the wiring, and sorted it for a fair price. Really professional bloke—knew exactly what he was doing. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our whole house rewired. Bit daunting at first, but they explained everything clearly and worked round our schedule. Minimal disruption, left the place tidy, and gave us all the paperwork we needed. Top job.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Landlord insisted on an electrical safety check before letting the flat. These lads were quick, professional, and the report was thorough. Gave me confidence the place is safe. Would use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: David P.
